author: codex-ai-reviewer-s2
purpose: Independent AI visual reference proposals for the prefixed TRAIN acquisition; root adjudicates. No real accuracy or human-ground-truth claim.
ui_access: Local raw RGB raster previews and registered numeric/mask assets; no browser writes.
coordinate_convention: [xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax], native pixel edges, upper-left origin, half-open

first_pass_before_proposal_geometry.subsequent_exposure: After freezing the independent raw pass, inspected root first-pass, the 2026 quay context and query of proposal IDs/geometries/counts. All eight observations had zero proposals. No model scores used.

second_reviewer_comparison.agreement: Same two vessels; red PBR and white STC. Other waterfront signatures stay unknown.
second_reviewer_comparison.box_changes_after_comparison: PBR first-pass red box ymax increased from 695 to 696 to include the southern red edge. STC first-pass probable box expanded from [442,1097,460,1108] to [441,1097,462,1110] after native focal inspection; it agrees with root and was not moved to force a zone category.

method: Read raw full native RGB panels and all zone crops before root decisions or model proposals.
Inspected observable/cloud/shadow/valid masks; neither positive has masked pixels. Original assets remain unchanged.
Positive boxes are native pixel localization windows, not surveyed hull outlines or physical dimensions.
Exclude uncertain waterfront contacts and positive neighborhoods from negatives. STC anchorage is predominantly land, so retain only an explicitly inspected marine subset.

Use the fixed configured geometry for nominal center assignment. The STC white hull center is effectively on its provisional boundary; preserve this uncertainty and exclude its entire neighborhood from patios.
No family, length or width inferred; all such fields are null. AI review does not establish absence of tiny or low-contrast vessels.

context_reference.purpose: Infrastructure comparison only; not synchronous ground truth or identity matching. Existing pilot context, excluded from the phase2 selection.

consolidation_notes: Only two unique positive vessels; detector proposed zero for the eight observations.

Assign white STC nominally to muelles by its unchanged box centroid, but its localization uncertainty exceeds the distance to the patios boundary. Its complete box and a three-pixel neighborhood are excluded from patios training, so no visible hull fragment becomes a negative.
Do not count stc_fondeo as a representative anchorage or land as marine absence.
